notes: This is a Mo Willems Elephant & Piggie book. The two main characters — Piggie (pig) and Gerald (elephant) — are distinctive named characters and will not be represented adequately by generic Boardmaker pig or elephant symbols. A whale character also appears as the 'big guy' who takes the ball; if a whale slot were needed it could replace one word, but the core conflict and vocabulary centres on ball, size contrast (big/small), taking, sadness, asking, and sharing. Secondary character Gerald the Elephant (Piggie's best friend) is central to the story and also needs sourcing. The resolution involves sharing and playing together, making 'share' and 'play' high-value fringe words for comprehension and retell activities.
